## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run ci` passes locally (validate, coverage, lint, type-check, test, build, examples).
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has a test in `test/`.
- [ ] If the ontology changed: `npm run validate` reports 0 errors, and
      `ontology/periodic-table.schema.json` still describes the shape.
- [ ] If coverage improved or dropped, `npm run coverage` output is reflected
      in `README.md` (Status, Limitations, Roadmap).
- [ ] Documentation updated. `docs/EVAL_RESULTS.md` reflects any change to
      evaluation methodology or numbers.
- [ ] No claim of an empirical result that has not been measured.
